title: Northgate Delivery & Installation Crew Re-Slot Surcharge for Stair-Carry Appointments
content:
**What is the crew re-slot surcharge on a Northgate Delivery & Installation appointment?**

A crew re-slot surcharge is added to the reschedule fee of each move that owes a fee, because moving an appointment that needs a stair-capable crew means finding such a crew again. It follows the flights of stairs the appointment's stair-carry entries carry as their units in all:

| Flights on the appointment's stair-carry entries, in all | Surcharge added to each owed move |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | $15.00 |
| 1 or 2 | $5.00 |
| No stair-carry entry | Nothing |

**Are several stair-carry entries added together?**

Yes. The flights are the units of all the appointment's stair-carry entries taken together.

**Does the surcharge apply once per appointment or per move?**

Per move: it is added to the fee of each move that owes one.

**Hypothetical appointments.**

- Stair-carry entries of 1 flight and 2 flights: 3 flights in all, $15.00 per owed move.
- One stair-carry entry of 2 flights: $5.00 per owed move.
- No stair-carry entry: nothing.
